title: (Remote) Presentation Specialist
description:
Remote role

The Creative Services Lead is responsible for developing high-quality visual assets that ensure consistent brand representation and elevate the firm's visual identity. The role will bring expertise in producing impactful brand and marketing materials that help shape and strengthen our brand identity. They will partner with Brand Marketing on the vision and strategy for how the Client's brand is represented in the Americas.

Deliverables
• Create, develop and execute high-quality visual assets that ensure consistent and compelling brand representation across all platforms and channels
• Partner with Brand Marketing and key stakeholders to translate brand strategy into impactful creative concepts and deliverables
• Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to deliver creative assets that align with business objectives and brand standards
• Support the evolution of the firm's look and feel through the production of modern, on-brand marketing materials, templates, resource guides, fact sheets, etc
• Update, maintain and apply brand guidelines to ensure visual consistency, quality, and accuracy
• Ability to adhere to and stay within existing brand guidelines while maintaining creative lense
• Implement, document and manage relevant best practices, identifying and improving inefficiencies
• Create and manage workflows from concept through final delivery, ensuring timelines, priorities, and quality standards are met
• Build, curate and maintain brand image libraries that support consistent brand expression, efficient asset usage, and strong visual governance
• Ensure marketing collateral is thoughtfully structured and formatted, applying sound design principles to support clarity, readability, and brand consistency
• Identify opportunities to refresh and enhance brand imagery to keep creative expression current and effective
• Balance creative innovation with business needs, delivering solutions that are both visually engaging and strategically sound
• Ensure alignment with global business partners, identifying opportunities to collaborate
• Act as a trusted advisor on all brand related initiatives, leveraging industry knowledge and expertise
• Strong understanding of corporate branding, specifically within B2B organizations

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Hybrid Role

Talent Acquisition Coordinator

The Talent Acquisition team is responsible for the recruiting process that enables our stakeholders across the firm to hire the right talent for Client's Americas Division.

This role is for a Recruiting Coordinator to support the Recruiters and TA Leads. This person will collaborate with recruiters to schedule interviews and logistics, maintain recruiting data within the HR systems and reporting tools, provide an excellent candidate experience, create and distribute offer packages. This position requires an individual who can multi-task and work well under pressure in demanding environment all while remaining extraordinarily organized and having a keen eye for detail.

The team is supporting a growing business and there could be additional career opportunities in the future for an individual that proves they have the ability to learn and develop professionally.

Role Objectives
• Coordinate each stage of the candidate experience, including interview scheduling/follow-up notifications, creating and distributing offer package materials as well as some aspects of the pre-employment process.
• Provide exceptional client service to candidates and hiring managers throughout the entire hiring process
• Point of contact for candidates, recruiters, hiring managers and external agencies for all interview scheduling and offer packages
• Draft offer letters in our Applicant Tracking System requiring meticulous attention to detail
• Maintains data integrity of recruiting system as well as Internet and social media recruitment
• Maintains interview scheduling data in an excel tracker
• Participate in Recruiting and HR related projects on an ad hoc basis

Qualifications and Skills
• 0-1 year of experience in a corporate environment whether it be full-time experience or internship experience
• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Communications, Marketing or related field of study
• Strong MS Office skills including Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
• Strong interpersonal skills and confidence in dealing with individuals at all levels, including communication (verbal and written), emotional intelligence and cultural intelligence.
• Excellent attention to detail
• Due to the nature of the high/constant volume of the role, the individual must apply effective problem solving, multi-tasking, organizational, and prioritization skills
• Demonstrates the highest standards of ethics, integrity, honesty, and discretion
• Ability to prioritize, plan and execute projects and individual tasks
• Ability to effectively learn, articulate and promote the Client's brand to potential candidates
• Build strong relationships with HR Business Partners and internal stakeholders
• Knowledge of any applicant tracking system (ATS) or recruiting system is a plus
